steps.en: Sign up at Snyk and export your API token
steps.zh: 注册 Snyk 账号，把 API token 设成环境变量

steps.en: Run it with no arguments to scan the whole machine
steps.zh: 不带参数运行，扫描整台机器

steps.en: Finds the agents, MCP server configs and skills installed on this machine
steps.zh: 找出本机装了哪些 agent、MCP 服务配置和 skill

steps.en: Approve or decline each MCP server it wants to start or contact
steps.zh: 逐个批准或拒绝它要启动或连接的 MCP 服务

steps.en: Starts approved servers, reads their tool descriptions, redacts secrets
steps.zh: 启动获批的服务，读取工具描述，抹掉密钥

steps.en: Sends descriptions and skill files to Snyk's API, prints scored risks
steps.zh: 把描述和 skill 文件发给 Snyk 接口，打印带分数的风险

value.en: One command shows which installed MCP servers and skills carry injection or malware risk — no hand-reading every tool description
value.zh: 一条命令看出已装的 MCP 服务和 skill 里哪些带注入或恶意代码风险，不用逐个手读工具描述

sources: https://github.com/snyk/agent-scan README Quick Start (sign up, `export SNYK_TOKEN=your-api-token-here`, `uvx snyk-agent-scan@latest`)
README Security Warning + Interactive Consent for MCP Servers (y/n consent per server; stdio commands executed, remote URLs contacted)
README Analysis and Validation (data sent to the Agent Scan API; secrets redacted before transmission)
docs/scanning.md How It Works; docs/risks.md (scored risk indicators, 100/300/600/1000)
repo tree src/agent_scan/agents/*.py (one discoverer per agent), src/agent_scan/mcp_client.py, src/agent_scan/redact.py
